archetypes.name: bash-harness
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes a Bash regression harness and PATH-stub behavior where false positives and portability issues are easy to miss.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Bash harness changes around the nested find failure stub, PATH_PREFIX handling, stderr capture, and cleanup case ordering. Check whether the new test actually exercises should_remove_by_age failure rather than bypassing enumeration or another find call. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: docs-drift
archetypes.rationale: Most changes are cross-document contract updates, so consistency with the actual cleanup semantics is the main review risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the documentation updates for internal consistency and alignment with cleanup.sh behavior. Look for remaining stale top-level-mtime claims, mismatched cache versus tmp enumeration details, and contradictory fail-safe or fail-open wording. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ops-retention
archetypes.rationale: The cleanup retention behavior deletes potentially sensitive session state, so operator-facing semantics and failure modes deserve targeted review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess the operator and security implications of the described cleanup retention model. Focus on whether the bounded maxdepth 5 tradeoff, scan failure behavior, symlink boundary, and cache versus tmp deletion paths are accurately surfaced where users would rely on them. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
